import sqlite3
import csv

# Create a combined database
conn = sqlite3.connect('/tmp/combined.sqlite')
cursor = conn.cursor()

# Copy posts from posts.db
posts_conn = sqlite3.connect('/home/tako/urp/react/data/public/input/task_259/context/db/posts.db')
posts_cursor = posts_conn.cursor()
posts_cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM posts')
posts_data = posts_cursor.fetchall()
posts_columns = [desc[0] for desc in posts_cursor.description]

# Create posts table and insert data
cursor.execute('CREATE TABLE posts (Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, PostTypeId INTEGER, AcceptedAnswerId INTEGER, CreaionDate TEXT, Score INTEGER, ViewCount INTEGER, Body TEXT, OwnerUserId INTEGER, LasActivityDate TEXT, Title TEXT, Tags TEXT, AnswerCount INTEGER, CommentCount INTEGER, FavoriteCount INTEGER, LastEditorUserId INTEGER, LastEditDate TEXT, CommunityOwnedDate TEXT, ParentId INTEGER, ClosedDate TEXT, OwnerDisplayName TEXT, LastEditorDisplayName TEXT)')
cursor.executemany('INSERT INTO posts VALUES (' + ','.join(['?']*len(posts_columns)) + ')', posts_data)

# Copy comments from comments.csv
with open('/home/tako/urp/react/data/public/input/task_259/context/csv/comments.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    comments_data = [(row['Id'], row['PostId'], row['Score'], row['Text'], row['CreationDate'], row['UserId'], row['UserDisplayName']) for row in reader]

cursor.execute('CREATE TABLE comments (Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, PostId INTEGER, Score INTEGER, Text TEXT, CreationDate TEXT, UserId INTEGER, UserDisplayName TEXT)')
cursor.executemany('INSERT INTO comments VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', comments_data)

conn.commit()
print('Combined database created successfully')
print('Posts count:', cursor.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts').fetchone()[0])
print('Comments count:', cursor.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments').fetchone()[0])
conn.close()
